uncertainties: Var-Xe-LD's affectionate spoken pronunciation is represented by primary displayed name as requested.
text:
Wahahahaha!
Y-yes, you're right!
Please keep
guiding me!
Indeed.
Excuse me...
You there...
Hm?
Here! Over here!
I am underneath
this rubble...
Under here, huh...
Heave... ho!
Under here?
Heave... ho!
...Wait, is this
a suit of mechanical armor???
Negative!
Wha!?
The armor talked!?
I am not armor.
I am a mechanical soldier!
Model designation VR731LD.
Heavy assault and gunnery unit
Var-Xe-LD.
Please, call me
Var-Xe-LD,
with affection!
O-oh...
So what exactly
is a mechanical soldier
doing under a pile of rubble?
So what exactly
are you doing
under a pile of rubble?
An excellent question!
The fact is...
So, in other words...
you ran out of energy
and couldn't move.
Normally, this unit converts
light into energy and
can operate indefinitely...
But my solar panels
were damaged, and then I
was buried under this rubble.
I don't really understand,
but you can't move because
you aren't getting enough sunlight?
I see...
You couldn't move because
you weren't getting enough sunlight.
That is the situation...
Then you should
be all right now, right?
Then you should
be all right now, shouldn't you?
Negative!
This situation requires
immediate action!
My energy reserves are nearly
exhausted. At this rate, I will
shut down before recharging is complete!
What!?
If I may
be so bold,
I have a request...
A battery?
Well, naturally,
we have those.
I'll return it right away.
I just need to borrow one
for a little while...
I'll return it right away.
Could you lend me one
for a little while?
That is acceptable,
but what do you
intend to use it for?
Uh... Well...
